_comment: Your thresholds. These drive the deterministic half of the score — edit freely, no code changes needed.
_scoreMaxAgeHours: Judge postings up to this old, and treat them as "recent" in the app. Anything older is left ungraded and lives in All jobs: by then it has collected proposals and a score wouldn't change what you do.
_minRelevance: OFF by default (0) — every posting that clears your pay floor and the age cap goes to the judge. Your Upwork search query is already the filter, so on a normal run this rule changed nothing while risking the one failure that actually costs you: skipping a job you would have taken. Raise it only if you run broad, keyword-free searches and need to cap AI usage. A keyword scores 3 in the title, 1.5 in the skill tags, 0.5 in the body; 1.5 means "a keyword in the title or skills", 0.5 means "a keyword anywhere". Keywords come from profile/keywords.md and are still used to judge the best matches first.
_gates: Hard caps applied after the base score. A job you can't do stays low no matter how well it pays.
_prefFloor: How much preferences can drag a perfect skill match down. 0.7 = worst-case preferences still keep 70% of the base score.
_niceWeight: How much a missing nice-to-have costs relative to a must-have.
